physicalNotes: Radius 0.81 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1758 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 563,517 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
